Sewerage and Drainage Act
(Chapter 293A, Section 3(3))
Authorised Officers
N 2
G.N. No. S 208/1999
REVISED EDITION 2001
(31st January 2001)
The Director of Sewerage and Drainage has authorised the following officers of the Ministry of the Environment to act on his behalf:
(1)[Deleted by S 218/2001 wef 01/04/2001]
(2)the Environmental Health Officers in the Central Building Plan Unit, Pollution Control Department.
[S 536/2000 — 1.11.2000]
